_doc: FALLBACK snapshot only. plan.py and provision.sh read regions live with `clever addon providers show <id> --format json`; this file is used when the CLI cannot answer, and every use is labelled 'snapshot 2026-10-24' in the output.
snapshot_source: clever addon providers show <id> --format json (clever-tools 5.2.0), 17 providers

hds_proposed.doc: the ONLY HDS zone the skill proposes or writes (decision of 2026-10-26), read by plan.py as its single source: the other HDS zones are recognised in hds_zones, never proposed; a customer who needs one changes it himself. The POC runs in par with synthetic data until an HDS contract is declared signed, then in parhds

kubernetes.note: Clever Kubernetes (CKE) is never available in an HDS zone (Clever Cloud, verified 2026-10-24); BETA in clever-tools 5.2.0

price_grid_note: On 2026-10-24 the public grid returned identical runtime prices for zone_id=par and zone_id=parhds; any HDS-specific cost is in the HDS contract, not in this grid.
